explanation: ForkFree (no element divides two distinct other elements) and f(n) (the largest fork-free subset of {1..n}, via findGreatest bounded by n) match erdosproblems.com/1062. 'Is lim f(n)/n irrational?' is encoded as: the limit exists and is irrational. The page presupposes that the limit exists, so the combined claim is the natural affirmative reading of the open question.
